name: Nautical Nightmares
source:
Some say the world is black...white...and shades of gray?

Seeing is not always believing, and there's much to discovered aboard the elusive cruise ship setting sail across the sea.

Play as Nanno Makok, an heiress aboard a cruise set to sea, and fulfill your goal to wine and dine as something strange lurks afoot? Though the pressure is intense, do your best to maintain your reputation and see that maybe the world isn't so black and white after all.

And when you're done with that...

Play as a lone boy...set to live a simple life? The distant 80s period has not been kind to you, but after finally graduating from high school your life is about to change.  Act your best and when all seems lost, find the choices that bring you joy, because it's not the consequences that matter...but rather your intentions.

[From [url=https://rainyofus.itch.io/nautical-nightmares/devlog/638137/new-indie-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有人说世界是黑的……白的……还有灰色地带？

眼见不一定为实，在这艘难以捉摸的游轮上航行穿越大海时，有很多东西有待发现。

扮演Nanno Makok，一位在出海游轮上的女继承人，并在一些奇怪的东西潜伏时实现你的美酒佳肴的目标？尽管压力很大，但请尽力维护自己的声誉，并看到也许世界并不是那么黑白分明。

当你完成这些之后…

扮演一个孤独的男孩……准备过简单的生活吗？遥远的80年代对你并不友善，但高中毕业后你的生活即将改变。尽力而为，当一切似乎都已失败时，找到给你带来快乐的选择，因为重要的不是结果……而是你的意图。

[来自[url=https://rainyofus.itch.io/nautical-nightmares/devlog/638137/new-indie-game]itch.io[/url]]
